Frequently Asked Questions What is Yellow Pages Vietnam? Yellow Pages Vietnam (yellowpages.com.vn) is the English-language B2B directory that helps FDI enterprises operating in Vietnam and international buyers worldwide find, evaluate and connect with verified Vietnamese manufacturers, suppliers, exporters and service providers. It is operated by Viet Business Information and Technology JSC and has been a trusted B2B directory since 2010. Who uses Yellow Pages Vietnam? Two main audiences use the platform. First, FDI enterprises already operating in Vietnam, who use it for domestic sourcing of materials, machinery, logistics and services from local suppliers. Second, international buyers, importers and sourcing houses abroad who want to source from Vietnam for export to their home markets. How is Yellow Pages Vietnam different from Alibaba or Global Sources? Unlike export-focused marketplaces, Yellow Pages Vietnam also serves foreign companies sourcing inside Vietnam, with category and province filters built for domestic sourcing. Its listings come from a curated, verified business database maintained since 2010, and it connects buyers directly with suppliers with no marketplace middleman and no per-transaction fees. Do suppliers need to speak English to be listed? No. Vietnamese suppliers who do not speak English can still be found and chosen, because FDI buyers typically have Vietnamese staff who handle the final contact, quotation and contract. Is it free to list a business on Yellow Pages Vietnam? Yes. Businesses can create a free listing on Yellow Pages Vietnam. Paid advertising and enhanced listing options are also available for greater visibility to FDI and international buyers.
